description: A proper class cannot be represented by a set that is a member of any set A.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AxiomaticSetTheory.proper_class_not_represented.{u} (P : ZFSet.{u} → Prop)
  (hP : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AxiomaticSetTheory.IsProperClass P) (A : ZFSet.{u}) :
  ¬∃ x ∈ A, ∀ (y : ZFSet.{u}), y ∈ x ↔ P y
